notes:
Model-authored and unreviewed; checked on the fake backend only, with no hardware attached and no hardware run. The fake is a pure Python kinematic stand-in for HoverAviary, not the upstream MuJoCo model: it has no rigid-body contacts, RPM-to-thrust/torque actuator, ground effect, drag, downwash, wind, obstacles or sensors, and it was not compared with the upstream environment. The upstream simulator path (task.mock_strategy.preferred upstream-sim) was not run because the gate neither installs gymnasium/MuJoCo nor imports the clone; env_id is None because the clone re-exports the environment classes and the README constructs HoverAviary directly instead of registering a Gymnasium id. The observation is the 12-value scalar state, so there is no array to leave uncovered. Expected family-bridge warnings are left in place: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only configures the next reset and makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT warnings for ticks, action.values and the two seed inputs; declaring actions to add units was not done because it would expose undescribed reset inputs. test_driver.py keeps the check_driver call and adds 10 cases for the action bound, the hover reward, the three termination paths, the 10 s truncation, the seed, the fidelity contract and the e-stop latch.
